title: Nature-to-Earn
tagline: Incentive and reward based Attend-To-Earn platform where people attend events to learn about nature and earn while doing that.
description: Nature-to-Earn (N2E) is a purpose-driven token that rewards people for getting out into nature. We believe that connecting with nature pushes people to take better care of nature. By having N2E validators facilitate nature events (e.g. hikes, mushroom forays, beach cleanups, etc), we can verify people's participation in nature events & reward them accordingly
how_its_made: We have used Ipfs/filecoin for storing metadata of events and participants and worldcoin for verifying that a person can register only once for a event. This project is on polygon-mumbai testnet.We have used NFTs(ERC721) as a proof of attendence. Participants can mints these NFTs once they have attended the event and the event host has marked them as verified.
